sub_sector.value: excess and surplus specialty liability insurance; professional, casualty, healthcare liability

financial_business_type.detail: Specialty insurer underwriting professional, casualty and healthcare liability on admitted and non-admitted paper.

revenue_driver.detail: Earns premiums on primary and excess specialty liability policies; investment income on float.

customer_type.detail: Public companies, private businesses and nonprofits, reached through brokers.

balance_sheet_dependence.detail: Carries underwriting risk through its reinsurer, which assumes risks from American Family affiliates.
